WITH event_ratios AS (
    SELECT link_to_event AS event_id,
           SUM(spent) * 1.0 / SUM(amount) AS spend_ratio
    FROM budget
    WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL
      AND spent IS NOT NULL
      AND amount IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY link_to_event
),
average_ratio AS (
    SELECT AVG(spend_ratio) AS avg_spend_ratio
    FROM event_ratios
)
SELECT event_id,
       spend_ratio,
       spend_ratio / avg_spend_ratio AS relative_to_average
FROM event_ratios
CROSS JOIN average_ratio
ORDER BY relative_to_average DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
